# Purpose

Break the approved specification into QA execution tasks.

# Output

Generate tasks.md

Include tasks such as:

Requirement Review
Specification Review
Test Planning
Test Data Preparation
Functional Test Design
Negative Test Design
Boundary Test Design
UI Validation
Regression Test Preparation
Smoke Test Preparation
Test Execution
Defect Logging
Defect Verification
Regression Execution
Test Closure

For each task include:

Task ID
Description
Priority
Dependencies
Deliverable
Estimated Effort (if possible)
